title: An ordinary loan repayment posts ONE 250.00 credit to LOAN_PORTFOLIO 10 and ONE 250.00 debit to the resolved fund source 4 (loan 14 L66, principal-only)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an ORDINARY repayment posted under createJournalEntriesForLoanRepayments, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 6, loan 14 not charged off) at repayment transaction L66. request.repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's repayment transaction id 66 (externalId c7edadd7-c7b8-4e9d-b4b6-b347bd1d6dbe, type loanTransactionType.repayment, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 11 AUTOPAY): principalPortion 250.0 -> "25000" minor units, interest/fee/penalty/overpayment 0 and omitted. request.repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: loanPortfolioAccountId 10, receivableInterest/Fee/PenaltyAccountId 7, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 18, fundSourceAccountId 4; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17, so paymentType 11 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 4. expect.repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the two L66 legs in id order from the journal-entries read-back: JE 142 CREDIT account 10 250.00, JE 143 DEBIT account 4 250.00. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: an ordinary repayment CREDITS each non-zero portion to its slot account, MERGING portions that share a credit account at the first slot's position, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source, credits first and the single debit last. A port that credits the wrong slot account or debits an account other than the resolved fund source moves a leg. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the one-debit-vs-debit-per-portion discriminator — with a single credited portion the two postings coincide, so this vector does not distinguish them (the loan-18 L93 and loan-19 L98 vectors do); the excluded branches (goodwill credit, transfer, isIncomeFromFee, charge refund, tax) have no input and are not expressible. The journal-entries read-back holds only these two legs for L66: no later reversal of L66 is present, so only the original posting's legs are transcribed. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
